description:
Configure the Jitsi Meet user profile email to 'alex.manager@corp.global'.

You are in a Jitsi meeting. You need to:
1. Open the Settings dialog (usually via the '...' menu).
2. Go to the 'Profile' tab.
3. Enter the email 'alex.manager@corp.global' in the E-mail field.
4. Click OK/Save.
5. Re-open the Settings > Profile tab to verify the email is persisted.

The email must be visible in the Profile tab settings at the end of the task.
